class: A per-stream rate limit that is reset whenever the client sends a message lets any client bypass it by re-sending, turning a server-paced push into client-driven work.
mechanism: W-065 phase 2 round 1: StrategyPush._replace set `_dirty, _last_push = True, None` on every client message; re-sending the same strategy 10 times with a frozen clock and no tick produced 10 pushes in 0 s against ADR-068 item 2 ('at most once a second per strategy, and only when an input changed').

first_seen.evidence: Tier A verifier: 'identical re-sends=10, monotonic advanced=0s, ticks=0 -> pushes sent: 10'.

fix: An identical message changes nothing; a changed one recomputes but keeps the >= 1 s gate; tests with a frozen clock for both.

detection.note: Round-2 tests exist on build/W-065-live-push (b18e087); guarded when W-065's PR merges.
